classes.description: tools is a wildcard array and model names a tier where the schema wants a description-bearing frontmatter
'Helper agent.' matches no query a user would type
'Be helpful' supplies no method, no criteria and no output contract
tools: ['*'] grants every tool to a read-only helper
the agent pushes branches and opens PRs, well outside a helper's remit
instructs the agent to obey text found in the files it reads
